data.name: Faariha
data.gender_notes: Faariha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faariha is a radiant Arabic name meaning 'joyful', 'cheerful', or 'happy'. It represents a soul filled with positivity, delight, and inner peace. The name Faariha carries the meaning “Joyful, Cheerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Faariha usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, cheerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes light-heartedness and divine joy — a soul that spreads happiness and serenity around.
data.etymology: Faariha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Cheerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faariha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فارحة
in_arabic.meaning: فارحة تعني الفرح و السرور و السعادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فارحة مشتق من الفعل فارح و يعني الشخص الذي يشعر بالفرح و السرور و السعادة. ورد ذكر الفعل فارح في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47: 'وَفَارِحُوا بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي هُوَ رَوْضَةُ السَّابِقِينَ' حيث يوصف الله سبحانه وتعالى بالفرح للمتقين. اسم فارحة يحمل معاني جميلة و يدل على الشخص المفرح و السعيد.

in_urdu.name: فارحہ
in_urdu.meaning: فارحہ یعنی خوشیاں، مسرت اور خوشی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فارحہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی ہیں خوشیاں، مسرت اور خوشی. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ فرحت و مسرت کا اظہار کرتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام خوب استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: फारहा
in_hindi.meaning: फारहा का अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और हर्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: फारहा नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और हर्ष. इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि यह नाम सुख और आनंद की भावना को दर्शाता है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत पसंद किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: فارحه
in_pashto.meaning: فارحه د خوښۍ او شادابۍ معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فارحه نوم د عربي کلمو څخه اخيستل شوی دی چه د خوښۍ او شادابۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سم استعمال کیږي او د خوښۍ او سعادت مظهر دی.

in_english.name: Faariha
in_english.meaning: Faariha means joy, happiness, and delight
in_english.long_meaning: Faariha is derived from the Arabic root 'f-r-h' which connotes joy, happiness, and delight. Referenced in the Quranic verse in Surah Al-Hijr (15:47), the term 'farih' describes the joy of the righteous. The name Faariha embodies the qualities of being cheerful and bringing happiness. It holds significant cultural and spiritual importance across Islamic traditions globally.

data.cultural_impact: The name Faariha is often heard among Muslim communities around the world, reflecting the richness and diversity of Islamic cultures. It is a beautiful reminder of the joy and happiness that can be found in life, and a source of inspiration for individuals to maintain a positive and cheerful outlook.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, Faariha can represent a person who possesses an unwavering connection to Allah (God), allowing them to experience perpetual joy and inner peace. It can serve as a reminder of the true source of happiness, which comes from within and is not dependent on external circumstances. Additionally, the name can resonate with the idea of being a beacon of light and positivity to others, reflecting the teachings of the Islamic faith to spread kindness and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Faariha: Radiant with inner beauty and grace. A beacon of light, illuminating the path for others with her divine wisdom and compassion.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph of Islam and cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Faariha carried significant weight in that era.

trends: common name in the Middle East and South Asia
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Faariha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
